continent-africa: The continent with the Sahara and the Nile
continent-antarctica: The ice-covered continent at the South Pole
continent-asia: The largest and most populous continent
continent-australia: The smallest continent, also a single country
continent-europe: Continent with the Alps, Paris and Rome
continent-north-america: Continent with the Rockies, Canada and Mexico
continent-south-america: Continent with the Amazon and the Andes
ocean-pacific: The largest and deepest ocean, with the Mariana Trench
ocean-atlantic: The ocean where the Titanic sank
ocean-indian: The ocean with the Maldives and Madagascar
ocean-arctic: The smallest, northernmost ocean, mostly frozen
ocean-southern: The ocean around the South Pole, officially recognised in 2000
lake-superior: The largest Great Lake by area and volume
lake-michigan: The only Great Lake entirely in the US, with Chicago on its shore
lake-huron: Great Lake with Georgian Bay and Mackinac Island
lake-erie: The shallowest Great Lake, with Cleveland and Buffalo on its shores
lake-ontario: The smallest Great Lake, just below Niagara Falls, with Toronto on its shore
